# FutureCount

FutureCount Holdings LLC is led by Eric Bass. It helps owners of small and midsize businesses strengthen their companies, develop a practical strategy, and implement it. Goals may include growth, continued family ownership, an ownership transition or a strategic sale.

## Pages
- [Why I created FutureCount](https://futurecountllc.com/)
- [How I work](https://futurecountllc.com/diagnostic.html): Business Diagnostic, strategy and implementation.
- [About Eric](https://futurecountllc.com/about.html): Selected experience and public sources.
- [Talk with Eric](https://futurecountllc.com/contact.html): A 30-minute introductory conversation; separate from a scoped Business Diagnostic engagement.

Website information is general and does not replace professional tax, legal or investment advice.
